summary.zh: 分析财报、用 DCF 估值并解释预算差异
summary.en: Analyzes statements, values with a DCF, explains variance

description.zh: 分析财务报表，用现金流折现给公司估值，解释实际支出与预算的差异，并搭建滚动预测。适合投资评估、经营复盘或年度预算编制时做量化分析。
description.en: Analyzes financial statements, values a company with a DCF, explains why spend missed budget and builds rolling forecasts. Useful for investment review, operating check-ins or annual budgeting.
